# MuPDF.js 1.28.1

Unmodified runtime files from the exact npm dependency `mupdf@1.28.1`.
Run `npm ci && npm run vendor:mupdf` to reproduce these files.

MuPDF is Copyright Artifex Software, Inc. and distributed under
AGPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSE), with alternative commercial licensing available.
The existing project's permissive license does not replace this dependency's
license. Distribution/deployment with this engine must comply with its AGPL
terms or use an appropriate commercial license.

Upstream source and build instructions: https://mupdf.com/releases/
Source repository: https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/mupdf
Documentation: https://mupdf.readthedocs.io/

The engine is loaded locally in a Web Worker, only when editing existing text.
PDF bytes are never sent to a server.
